title: Set up your practice
lead: A few short steps, and clients can book you online. You can stop at any time; we remember where you were.
progressText: Take the steps in order. Each button takes you to the right screen; come back here when you're done.
allDoneText: Your practice is set up. You can always change things later under Settings.
help: Stuck? Call <phone></phone> and we'll do it together.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.text: A short introduction in Dutch and English, so clients get to know you.

services.title: Your treatments and prices
services.text: Add what you offer, how long it takes and what it costs. You also choose the deposit clients pay when they book.

times.title: When you work
times.text: Choose the times clients can book you: your working hours, or the room blocks you reserve.

policy.title: Cancellation rules
policy.text: Decide how long before an appointment clients can cancel for free. Clients see this before they pay.

payments.title: Online payments
payments.text: Link your own payment account so deposits go straight to you. We'll let you know when this is ready.

preview.title: Look at your booking page
preview.text: See what clients see when they book you.

bannerTitle: Your practice is {done} of {total} set up
bannerText: A few more steps and clients can book you online.
